svg.title: Dumbbell Goblet Squat: how to perform
svg.desc: Shown from the front and side: holding a dumbbell upright against the chest with the feet about shoulder width, the hips sit down and back until the thighs are parallel, knees tracking over the toes and chest up, then drive up through the heels.
svg.text: Dumbbell at the chest, feet shoulder width
Thighs parallel, knees over the toes
Drive up through the heels · 1 s
Knees stay soft at the top
